en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large multi‑storey baroque/neo‑classical complex with a courtyard and bare trees in the foreground. The building has dormer windows in the roof and two church-like towers with onion domes rising from the rear, indicating a religious institution combined with another function. At the bottom of the image there is a printed German caption.
